title: The 3 programming paradigms that AI cannot replace

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if I told you AI can't replace these 3 programming styles?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: We're seeing a surge in systems that demand human-level logic and creativity.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Functional programming is all about pure functions and immutability.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s used in mission-critical systems like NASA’s flight software.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Developers need to think deeply about data flow and state.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Remember: AI can’t handle the complexity of functional design.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What’s one paradigm you’d never want an AI to touch?
